theme_strategy.rationale: Government service portals require a high level of trust, accessibility, and readability. A light theme with solid structured layout works best, emulating the official ekharid.haryanafood.gov.in portal.

headings.strategy: Bold, clear, authoritative. Use tracking-tight for large headings.

colors.instructions: Update the root CSS variables in index.css to match these colors using HSL equivalents. Primary: HSL(115 91% 28%), Secondary: HSL(27 98% 47%).

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle shadows for cards (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`). Avoid excessive glowing effects to maintain a professional government portal look.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (`border-slate-200` or `border-border`) on most containers to clearly separate content areas. Use top border accents on service cards (e.g., `border-t-4 border-primary`).
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-md or rounded-lg for a modern yet formal look.

motion.strategy: AOS animations (fade-up, zoom-in) for scrolling sections. Fast, subtle micro-interactions on hover (e.g., `-translate-y-1`, `shadow-md`).
motion.marquee: Continuous slow scrolling for the Notice Board/Updates section.

layouts.general: Centered containers (`max-w-7xl mx-auto`), clear distinct sections with generous padding (`py-12` or `py-16`).
layouts.top_bar: Flex layout, small text, dark green background. Contains contact info (Email, Phone) on left, Login/Register buttons and Language toggle on right.
layouts.navbar: Sticky, white background, flex-between. Use dropdowns for multi-level items (e.g., Services -> Solar, Loan).
layouts.hero: Full width image slider with a dark gradient overlay (`bg-black/40`). Overlay text with primary and secondary CTA buttons.
layouts.notice_board: Scrolling Marquee with an orange or distinct background. Highlight 'Latest Updates' or 'Important Notices'.
layouts.quick_services: CSS Grid `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4`. Cards should have distinct icons and provide clear pathways to forms.

component_instructions.icons: Use 'react-icons/fa' (Font Awesome) exclusively as requested. Run `yarn add react-icons`.
component_instructions.marquee: Use 'react-fast-marquee' for the scrolling notice board. Run `yarn add react-fast-marquee`.
component_instructions.aos: Use 'aos' package. Run `yarn add aos`. Initialize it in App.jsx. Add `data-aos='fade-up'` etc. to elements.
component_instructions.cards: Use custom HTML/Tailwind for main landing page cards (Quick Services) for easier AOS integration.
component_instructions.forms_and_tables: Use Shadcn components for Solar Registration, Loan Application, User Dashboard, etc.

Rural farmer representing local context in Sirsa, Haryana.
Man installing solar panels on a roof for Installation Request section.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA compliance. High contrast text on buttons and backgrounds.
accessibility.bilingual: Design UI to comfortably handle longer text strings in Hindi.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing shadcn components from src/components/ui.
NEVER center align the main App container or body. Left-align text naturally.
Create depth with borders and subtle shadows rather than flat generic layouts.
NEVER use a fully transparent background for headers/navs if content scrolls beneath. Use white or solid colors.
All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes.
DO NOT use placeholder text or mock URLs for images. Use the provided image URLs.
DO NOT use AI emoji characters. Strictly use react-icons/fa (FontAwesome).
Add `transition-all duration-300` carefully; avoid overriding necessary transform animations.
Emulate the professional structure of the eKharid portal: Top Bar, Navbar, Hero, Marquee, Grid content.
Ensure Poppins font is loaded via Google Fonts.
